findings.title: Duplicate is authorized by the ability source that has no rule
findings.body: canDuplicate is the OR of the ruler ability and the Grafana prom ability, and a missing rule is not treated as "no opinion". useRulerRuleAbilities(undefined) still marks Duplicate supported whenever the ruler is available, because isPluginProvidedRule(undefined) is false and allowance is only the global Grafana create permission. useGrafanaPromRuleAbilities(skipToken) does the same: skipToken is turned into undefined, useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities then sets MaybeSupported to AlwaysSupported, and Duplicate is allowed for anyone with Grafana AlertingRuleCreate. The permissive side wins. In the new list, plugin-provided rules therefore show Duplicate even though the prom path correctly denies it. In any AlertRuleMenu caller that has a cloud or other non-Grafana prom rule (or no prom rule), skipToken still grants Duplicate from the Grafana create permission, including when the ruler path says duplication is unsupported or the user lacks external-rule write. The menu item does not need a ruler rule, so the click starts the clone flow for a rule that should not be offered.

findings.title: Federated rule groups are no longer immutable
findings.body: useAllAlertRuleAbilities now delegates to useAllRulerRuleAbilities, which hardcodes isFederated to false. The previous isFederatedRuleGroup(rule.group) check was removed, and RuleGroupIdentifierV2 does not carry source_tenants, so the TODO cannot be evaluated with the data this hook receives. immutableRule is therefore never set for Mimir/GEM federated groups. Edit, delete, pause, and restore stay enabled for those rules in every consumer of these hooks, not only the new list. Users can change or delete cross-tenant federated rules that the UI previously blocked, which can break multi-tenant evaluation or drop rules the normal editor cannot represent.

findings.title: Delete never appears in the ruler-less list view
findings.body: The Delete item is rendered only when canDelete && rulerRule. GrafanaRuleListItem passes only promRule into RuleActionsButtons, so rulerRule is undefined and Delete is omitted even when useGrafanaPromRuleAbilities allows it. The list handler already deletes via the prom-derived identifier and ignores the ruler-rule argument, so the guard drops a working action. Users with delete permission cannot delete Grafana-managed rules from the list.

findings.title: Pause is unreachable without a ruler rule
findings.body: The pause item is still rendered only when rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rulerRule) is true, and MenuItemPauseRule requires that ruler payload. The list view no longer fetches or passes a ruler rule, so Pause/Resume never appears even when the new prom ability says pause is supported and allowed. Removing the guard alone would pass undefined into MenuItemPauseRule. After this change, pausing or resuming an alert from the list is impossible.

findings.title: Silence menu item is a no-op in the list view
findings.body: AlertRuleMenu shows "Silence notifications" from prom-rule abilities and does not require a ruler rule. handleSilence only sets showSilenceDrawer. The drawer is mounted only when rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule) is true, and the list calls RuleActionsButtons with promRule and no ruler rule, so the click never opens SilenceGrafanaRuleDrawer. Users get an enabled Silence action that does nothing.

findings.title: Recording rules lose export, pause, and restore
findings.body: useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities gates ModifyExport, Pause, Restore, and DeletePermanently on prometheusRuleType.grafana.alertingRule. The ruler hook it replaces uses rulerRuleType.grafana.rule, which is true for Grafana recording rules as well. Recording rules are Grafana-managed, share isPaused / is_paused with alerting rules, and previously could be exported. In the list view Export is hidden for every recording rule, and pause/restore stay unsupported even for users who can edit them.

findings.title: Filtered Grafana rows are rendered without a key
findings.body: FilterViewResults maps each result to a list child and previously set key={key} on GrafanaRuleLoader. The replacement GrafanaRuleListItem omits key, while the datasource and unknown branches still set it. React reconciles Grafana rows by index. RuleActionsButtons holds silence-drawer and clone redirect state on the row, so loading more results or refreshing the filtered list can attach that state to the wrong rule.

findings.title: View links drop returnTo
findings.body: The deleted list item built the view href with createReturnTo() so the rule detail page could link back to the current list URL, including filters and search. The new href is /alerting/grafana/${uid}/view with no returnTo query param. Opening a rule from the filtered or grouped list and using the in-app back link lands on the default list instead of restoring the user's place.

findings.title: Menu test locks in the incomplete action set
findings.body: The More-menu test grants AlertingRuleDelete and folder update/delete, defines a delete selector, and then expects exactly four items: silence, copy link, duplicate, and export. It never clicks Silence and never asserts Delete or Pause. That count matches the current bugs (Delete and Pause omitted, Silence not required to open a drawer) and will fail a fix that shows the missing actions, so CI freezes the incomplete menu. Nothing covers plugin-provided or cloud rules, which is what would catch Duplicate being granted by an empty ability source.
